-- Spec: append a copy of s to the borrowed list dst, in place.

-- Pure model of the result: dst with a copy of s added at the end.
with_name(dst: List[str], s: str) -> List[str] =
  post out.len() == dst.len() + 1
  ex with_name(["a"], "b") == ["a", "b"]
  var r = copy dst
  r.append(copy s)
  r

-- dst is mutated, so it is a var parameter; the caller passes &names.
-- Returns nothing. s is only borrowed, so the stored value is a copy.
add_name(var dst: List[str], s: str) =
  pre s.char_count() >= 0
  post dst.len() >= 1
  dst.append(copy s)
